        # Update weights every 50 iterations

                if trials[i] > 0:
                    rate = successes[i] / trials[i]
                else:

                # Update weight: increase if above average, decrease if below
                # Average expected rate is 1/num_ops ~ 0.333
                weights[i] = max(0.1, weights[i] * (0.9 + 0.1 * (rate - 0.33) / 0.33 if rate > 0.33 else 1.0))
            # Reset accumulators
            successes = [0.0 for _ in range(num_ops)]
            trials = [0 for _ in range(num_ops)]
